analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + MACD improving + Higher Low recovery

analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 53.1 to 62.3, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 0.1676 to 0.8039, indicating strengthening bullish momentum. The 5-day low of $204.27 is higher than the 20-day low of $181.24, forming a Higher Low pattern. Volume surged 3.47x the 5-day average, reinforcing buying pressure.
